lead_profile_text: Existing property looking for a higher return (Facebook enquiry)
stl_goal: Higher return than a standard let; actively comparing management models and prefers a guaranteed rent arrangement
property_situation: 4-bed house, brand-new full refurbishment (stripped to the wall, rewired, replumbed, new kitchen and bathrooms, new flooring), keys just collected, completely unfurnished. Many prospective tenants queuing. Owner also has a Winchester property switched to guaranteed rent and a Manchester property. Parking needs a council permit (annual permit about 70 pounds; public car park across the street; considering buying a spot on the adjacent industrial estate). Mortgage question was asked but not answered; Monday rent/mortgage column shows '350k' (meaning unclear).
primary_blocker: Wants a guaranteed-rent model, which Stayful does not offer on a managed basis; distrusts the 450 pound ADR; holds competing management proposals at 8 to 12 percent against Stayful's 15 percent
language_signals: I'm a bit picky about whom should I choose
Do I just hand over the keys to you and then expect that $4,000 coming to my account?
it's definitely a little bit on the higher side of what, um, you know, I'm thinking
my preference would be Zach at this point in time
I would prefer, uh, sort of like, uh, you know, a guaranteed rate
only when you make the property occupied completely, only then I earn

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: I'm just holding on and, uh, maybe the next one week I need to decide either which way
delay_signals.context: Comparing several management proposals, including very low commission rates; wants Zac to 'think through it and then see what best that you could offer'

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: It's unfurnished. It does not have anything. When you walk in, you would find empty rooms, walls
delay_signals.context: Property is entirely unfurnished; furnishing cost and approach not yet agreed. Zac offered a free setup guide or a furnishing quote once he has photos
delay_signals.timeline_given: Photos to be sent via WhatsApp; Zac to reply by end of the day

green_light_signals.trigger_phrase: my preference would be Zach at this point in time
green_light_signals.context: Stated after describing competing offers; preference for Zac is conditional on a guaranteed-rent style arrangement

green_light_signals.trigger_phrase: maybe the next one week I need to decide either which way
green_light_signals.context: Property is ready now, keys collected and tenants queuing, so a decision window of about a week was given

meeting_flow.opening_phrase: I thought I'd start by understanding a bit on your current situation. You know, interested in short letting. Um, yeah, just sort of where we're at with things, and then I can go through the figures and our service and see if it sort of lines up with what you're looking for.
rapport_topics: Audio and mute problems at the start
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: Right, I see. Okay, all right then. What I'll do then is I'll share my screen and we can go through some of the things then.
meeting_flow.income_intro: So we're looking at gross revenue about 92,000 per year, which is about 7,700 per month, should we say. Now this is a net revenue to you of about 48,000 per year, about 4,000 per month.
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: So we're a short letting management company. So how it works is we'll list you on the multiple platforms and it acts like a letting agent. So we'll charge 15% of the bookings that we take and then you will essentially keep the rest after the commissions from the platform.
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: If you send me some photos, I can take it into account and have a look and then let you know.
meeting_flow.close_phrase: Okay, all right, well, we'll have a good day, Babu. I'll get back to you probably by the end of today, and then we can go from there.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: what I want you guys to do is some homework about, how did I arrive at the figures, based on the market trend in that area
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Figures come from 12 comparables within about 6 km, with the property slotted in the middle; top comps around 140,000 pounds and several over 100,000.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Sorry, sorry, just stay there. I think we need to build 3 scenarios here.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: I think we need to build 3 scenarios here ... it should be on the low end of the spectrum, in my opinion ... the projection that you showed, it's definitely a little bit on the higher side of what I'm thinking
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Would shy away from using lowest and highest comps because of spec differences; a consolidated average is better. Added that a new listing will run 15 to 20 percent below projection for about 3 to 6 months until it has reviews, and the area is not highly competitive (under 100 reviews).

lead_responses.what_lead_said: average nightly rate you have taken?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: 450 pounds on average at 56 percent occupancy, so the rate could be run lower for higher occupancy; plenty of comps around 400, lowest 286, highest 800.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: what's the catch? ... Do I just hand over the keys to you and then expect that $4,000 coming to my account?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Asked if furnished; explained setup in 3 steps (furnishing and key safe, cleaner inspection and snagging, professional photos, then live); offered free setup guide or a furnishing quote.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: It's unfurnished. It does not have anything.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Do you work on a guaranteed rent basis, or what's your model?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: No, 15 percent of bookings taken; the lead keeps the rest after platform commissions; statement on the 1st, payout a few days later; lowest-case months should cover mortgage and bills.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Okay ... I have a different kinds of model people are talking me through ... rates as low as 8% till 12%

lead_responses.what_lead_said: It's not 15%, it's very high actually. So I've got rates as low as 8% till 12%
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Did not rebut the fee comparison; said he is happy to look at it and needs photos.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: think through it and then see like what best that you could offer and then we go from there.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: do you think that, since you've been in this space for more than 3 years, your sweet spot is to do a management than trying to do a rent-to-rent or a guaranteed rent kind of stuff?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Mostly management now (about 70 properties, team of about 7, started in 2020, managing for others since summer 2023); guaranteed rent carries VAT and fixed rent costs as you expand, but he still looks at rent-to-rent when he likes the landlord and property.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: That's completely, I understand. So let's be connected on WhatsApp.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: you need to have a parking permit to park there ... I've paid some 70 pounds for the entire year
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: No, that's useful. Because that is a big issue if it's permanent. So it's nice that that's been resolved for sure.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Yeah, yeah. So just that we need to manage that part.

conversion_gaps.gap: Fee objection unanswered: lead said competing proposals are 8 to 12 percent against Stayful's 15 percent and Zac did not explain what the fee covers or why it is higher
conversion_gaps.evidence: "It's not 15%, it's very high actually. So I've got rates as low as 8% till 12%"
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Prepare a fee-versus-value comparison (cleaning coordination, dynamic pricing, screening, 70-property data, review ramp) and ask what the lower quotes exclude

conversion_gaps.gap: Guaranteed rent: lead's preferred model is not offered on a managed basis, and Zac left a rent-to-rent door open without a clear position
conversion_gaps.evidence: "I would prefer, uh, sort of like, uh, you know, a guaranteed rate." Zac: "No, we don't work on that model, no." Later: "I do still look at stuff that's on a rent-to-rent basis."
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Decide in advance whether a rent-to-rent offer on this property is on the table; if not, say so plainly and reframe lowest-case coverage and downside protection

conversion_gaps.gap: Three-scenario request (best, median, worst) not met on the call; Zac defended the consolidated average
conversion_gaps.evidence: "I think we need to build 3 scenarios here."
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Send a three-scenario table (for example ADR 286, around 360 to 400, 450) with the first-year 15 to 20 percent discount shown openly

conversion_gaps.gap: Mortgage not answered and not pursued; ability of the low case to cover costs unconfirmed
conversion_gaps.evidence: Zac asked 'what's the current mortgage for the property at the moment?' and Babu changed the subject to the homework request
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Do not press; ask what he needs the property to cover once trust is built

conversion_gaps.gap: Demand-driver mismatch: lead thinks High Wycombe is contractor and corporate-led (NHS, HS2, M40) rather than holiday-led, which undermines a 450 pound ADR; Zac did not address contractor demand or rate
conversion_gaps.evidence: "That $460 or $450 nightly rate would be too ambitious"; contractors and 'people who work locally, either NHS or the H2'
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Re-run the comp set for contractor stays and show a contractor-weighted rate and occupancy case

zac_language.numbers_framing: Gross 92k to net 48k via platform commission, cleaning and laundry (about 18 percent of gross) and management 15 percent; range 2,200 (January) to 5,100 (July); first-year discount 15 to 20 percent
zac_language.objection_handling_pattern: Defends the consolidated average over extremes, explains the review ramp-up, then redirects to practical next steps (furnishing, photos) rather than answering the fee and model objection

what_they_focused_on: Three scenarios with a low-end case
what_they_needed_most: Plain explanation of fees and who does what at handover
what_fell_flat: Headline 450 pound ADR and 140k top comps
Silence on the 8 to 12 percent fee comparison
profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: With sceptical, numbers-led owners, lead with a low/median/high view and the first-year discount, drop the mortgage question until later, and prepare an answer on fee versus lower quotes and on guaranteed rent before the call
